rollback.mechanism: delete only an unmerged branch/worktree, or use one separately reviewed exact revert after merge; no provider runtime occurs before R2
rollback.trigger: any unauthorized writer, trust-zone/provenance/closure ambiguity, line breach, test skip, current-head finding, required-check failure, main regression, workflow dispatch, provider activity, or CD-containment failure
